definitions.gloss: point sticks; scoring sticks used in mahjong
definitions.explanation: Narrow stick-shaped tokens used to keep score in mahjong. Each player starts with a set number of points represented by these sticks, which are exchanged when a hand is won or lost.

examples.japanese: {点棒|てんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}って→配る：03921_kubaru⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: Distribute the point sticks and start the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{点棒|てんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: The loser passes point sticks to the winner.

examples.japanese: {点棒|てんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧なくなる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{飛|と}びとなり、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{時点|じてん}→時点：12970_jiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{対局|たいきょく}→対局：17420_taikyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}する→終了する：22990_shuuryousuru⟧。
examples.english: When all point sticks are lost, it's called tobi (bust), and the game ends at that point.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (points) and ⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧ (stick/rod). Standard mahjong sets include four denominations of point sticks, each distinguished by colored dots: 100 points, 1,000 points, 5,000 points, and 10,000 points.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {点棒|てんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: pay point sticks
- {点棒|てんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: receive point sticks
- {点棒|てんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなる: run out of point sticks
- {点棒|てんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧: count point sticks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {持|も}ち{点|てん}: one's current point total
- ⟦{配給|はいきゅう}→配給：07881_haikyuu⟧⟦{原点|げんてん}→原点：11828_genten⟧: starting point allocation (typically 25,000 or 30,000 points)
- {牌|はい}: mahjong tiles

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese mahjong (⟦{麻雀|マージャン}→麻雀：06986_maajan⟧), physical {点棒|てんぼう} are used in live play to track scores. Online mahjong games display the score digitally but the terminology remains the same. The expression {点棒|てんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (point sticks fly) means to go bankrupt in a game.
